name: Kasbah Tifoultoute
hero_subtitle: A quieter silhouette than Aït Benhaddou — views over the rocky plain west of town.

overview.title: Kasbah Above the Plain
overview.p1: Tifoultoute sits on a rise a short drive from Ouarzazate, a kasbah that has seen better centuries but still holds a strong outline against the sky. It is less visited than Aït Benhaddou, which means more space to walk and fewer sales pitches on the path.
overview.p2: You come for the position and the light, not for a fully restored interior. Some rooms may be closed or fragile — stay on sound footing and treat it as a viewpoint with history attached.
overview.p3: Late afternoon suits the walls; midday is harsh and less photogenic.

q1.question: How far from town?
q1.answer: A short drive — often combined with other west-side stops.

q2.question: Entry fee?
q2.answer: A small fee or tip for access is common — carry change.

q3.question: Is it restored?
q3.answer: Partially; expect a mix of sound and fragile sections.

q4.question: Do I need a guide at Kasbah Tifoultoute?
q4.answer: Optional for a simple visit; useful for history and safe paths on fragile mud brick.

q5.question: Is Kasbah Tifoultoute suitable for families?
q5.answer: Yes with supervision on steps, rooftops and uneven ground.

food.title: Bring water, eat in town
food.p1: Do not count on a full kitchen on site. Water from Ouarzazate and a meal before or after is the sensible plan.
food.p2: Tifoultoute is a viewpoint stop measured in under an hour for most people.
food.li2: Snack only if a stall looks active
food.li5: No need for a full picnic setup

tips.title: Practical Tips for Visiting Kasbah Tifoultoute

1.title: Pairing
1.desc: Works well after Aït Benhaddou if you still want one more kasbah outline without another full climb.

2.title: Footing
2.desc: Uneven earth and broken edges — closed shoes, no rushing near drops.

3.title: Light
3.desc: Late afternoon warms the mud walls; midday flattens everything.
